title: 第177章 生煎包
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这句话差点让林雪气死。

“行了！闭嘴！”

林雪指着门口，“你们俩，现在，立刻给我滚！你们被开除了！”

黄毛和紧身衣男对视一眼，嘴角同时勾起一抹冷笑。

“行啊。”

黄毛慢条斯理地解下身上的围裙，扔在操作台上，“开除没问题。把工资结了。”

张莉不可置信地瞪着他，“你还敢要工资？你把我们店口碑砸了，我不找你们赔钱就不错了！”

“哎，饭可以乱吃，话不能乱讲。”

黄毛往前走了一步，盯着张莉，“我们是按说明书操作的，微波炉坏了怪不到我们头上。一人四百，一共八百块。转账还是现金？”

紧身衣男拿出手机了，我们就去门口喊你们用冷冻预制菜骗钱。”

“你！”林雪指着他们，气得手都在发抖。

“给他们！”

张莉咬着牙拉住林雪，“别把事情闹大，现在已经够乱了。”

林雪深吸了一口气，扫码转了八百块钱。

“到账，八百元。”

听到提示音，黄毛满意地收起手机。

两人大摇大摆地走出厨房。

走到门口时，紧身衣男还故意大声说了一句，“走，这几天光热预制菜，看得我都想吐了。”

声音传回厨房，气得林雪一把将案板上的剪刀摔在地上。

林雪盯着黄毛和紧身衣男离开的背影，胸口剧烈起伏。

她转过头，把怒火直接对准了赵可儿。

“可儿！之前让你去招人，你怎么就招这种人？”

林雪提高音量说道，“一天到晚除了偷懒就是顶嘴，现在还把店里名声砸了！你长没长脑子？”

赵可儿本来就一肚子火，听到这话直接炸了。

“你冲我吼什么？”

赵可儿双手叉腰，委屈地翻了个白眼，“就这条件，我能招到人就算不错了！那我怎么知道他们会在微波炉定时上动手脚？”

“你怪我干嘛？有本事你去找啊！”

赵可儿越说越气，伸出手指着林雪，“开店这段时间，你除了每天站在收银台前照镜子算账，你还干过什么？你倒是每天拍拍手什么都不管，现在出事了全往我头上推！”

Page (1/3)

This sentence almost made Lin Xue angry to death.

"Okay! Shut up!"

Lin Xue pointed to the door, "You two, get out of here right now! You are fired!"

Huang Mao and the man in tights looked at each other, with a sneer on their lips.

"Okay."

Huang Mao slowly took off his apron and threw it on the operating table, "It's no problem to fire him. Just pay his salary."

Zhang Li stared at him in disbelief, "You still dare to ask for wages? You've ruined the reputation of our store. It's good if I don't ask you to pay for it!"

"Hey, you can eat randomly, but you can't talk randomly."

Huang Mao took a step forward and stared at Zhang Li, "We followed the instructions. We are not to blame if the microwave breaks down. Four hundred yuan per person, eight hundred yuan in total. Transfer or cash?"

The man in the tights took out his cell phone, and we went to the door to call you to cheat people out of frozen prepared dishes."

"you!Lin Xue pointed at them, her hands shaking with anger.

"Give them!"

Zhang Li gritted her teeth and pulled Lin Xue, "Don't make the matter a big deal, it's already messy enough."

Lin Xue took a deep breath and scanned the code to transfer 800 yuan.

"Arrived, eight hundred yuan."

Hearing the notification tone, Huang Mao put away his phone with satisfaction.

The two swaggered out of the kitchen.

When he walked to the door, the man in tights deliberately said loudly, "Let's go, the light-heated pre-made dishes these days make me want to vomit."

The sound was carried back to the kitchen, and Lin Xue was so angry that she threw the scissors on the chopping board to the ground.

Lin Xue stared at the backs of Huang Mao and the man in tights as they left, her chest rising and falling violently.

She turned her head and directed her anger directly at Zhao Keer.

"Ke'er!I asked you to recruit people before, why did you recruit people like this?"

Lin Xue raised her voice and said, "Besides being lazy and talking back all day, now it's ruining the store's reputation!Have you ever developed a brain?"

Zhao Ke'er was already very angry, and immediately exploded when he heard this.

"What are you yelling at me for?"

Zhao Ke'er put his hands on his hips and rolled his eyes in grievance, "With this condition, it's good if I can recruit people!So how do I know they mess with the microwave timing?"

"Why do you blame me?If you have the ability, go find it!"

Zhao Keer became angrier as she spoke and pointed her finger at Lin Xue, "During the time you opened the store, apart from standing in front of the checkout counter and looking in the mirror every day to settle accounts, what else have you done?You clap your hands every day and don't care about anything, but now when something goes wrong, you blame it all on me!"
